items.body: I don't want to get anybody's hopes up, but with BlizzCon 2026 now just over a week away, it really is starting to look like something—possibly something big —is happening in the world of StarCraft. The excitement began earlier this week when Korea's Chosun ( Google translated , via WCCFTech ) ran a story saying Nexon is close to finalizing a deal to develop a new game based on the StarCraft series. As Chosun noted, the series has been dormant since StarCraft Remastered in 2017; the last original StarCraft game, StarCraft 2, arrived all the way back in 2010. Despite that, the series remains hugely popular in Korea. The StarCraft subreddit took some issues with the report: For one thing, Chosun suggested the new game would be StarCraft 3, rather than the StarCraft shooter Nexon is reportedly working on . There are also concerns that the report might be accurate, given CEO Junghun Lee's enthusiasm for generative AI and microtransactions. Still, the timing seemed right: BlizzCon 2026 runs September 12-13, which is now less than two weeks away. items.title: A multi-month delay for Deus Ex turned into a huge payoff for one of its best characters, says designer Harvey Smith
items.summary: Smith's story about the late stages of Deus Ex development takes some time to get to the point, but it's a fun ride.
items.body: Nobody likes game delays. Sure, a delay is temporary and suck is forever , as Gabe Newell once said, but it still chafes. But sometimes a little extra development time can go a very long way. In a new interview with the NoClip podcast , immersive sim maestro Harvey Smith shared one such story about Deus Ex, explaining how it leveraged some extra post-production time to give a much bigger role to one of the game's most famous NPCs—and make it a much better game in the process. Smith's tale actually followed a remark by Ben Horne, his co-founder at the new Black Pony Immersive studio, who said, "You can elevate a good immersive sim into a great immersive sim in a very short amount of time, a matter of months, if you just protect a post-production time." Publishers generally don't want to hear that, Smith added—although he obviously agrees with the sentiment—and so 20-some years ago, when Ion Storm Austin asked Eidos for more time to tighten up Deus Ex, "We geared up for this giant fight." items.title: The bizarre spirit of classic Elder Scrolls games is alive and well in little lo-fi RPG A Short Quest
items.summary: A few hours with a recent playtest has me eager to play the full thing next year.
items.body: When a big old tree talks, I listen. He said, "I have a task of great importance," as soon as I opened my eyes, and who was I to turn him down? "Take this note to the King, it should be a short quest," he instructed, and although there is no king in the playtest for A Short Quest , I am eager to fulfill the tree's wishes when the whole game is out next year. There are actually a lot of mysterious things I found in the few hours I spent with A Short Quest that I'd like to know more about. Every time I passed by a pond it spoke and asked me to dance (jump three times) for a blueberry. I found a note in an old mine that told me how to find the "glyph cipher" on the side of a cart, but I still don't know what to do with it. And I'm still not sure why I was summoned into the underground domain of a ghost wizard who tried to kill me. A Short Quest reminded me of when I would watch a friend from middle school play Morrowind on his Xbox or when I played Oblivion for the first time. It's a lo-fi first-person RPG that's trying to evoke that earlier, goofier era of the form; back when an elf would fall out of the sky and drop a scroll of flight as a joke. items.summary: بداية قوية لنجم الملكي
items.body: بداية قوية لنجم الملكي أعلن ريال مدريد، مساء اليوم الخميس، الفائز بجائزة أفضل لاعب في الفريق عن شهر أغسطس/ آب، بعد انطلاقة قوية للموسم الجديد في الدوري الإسباني. وحسم النجم الفرنسي كيليان مبابي السباق لصالحه، متفوقًا على بقية لاعبي الفريق، وفي مقدمتهم الإنجليزي جود بيلينجهام، ليحصد أول جائزة شهرية له مع "الميرنجي" هذا الموسم. وجاء تتويج مبابي بعدما سجل 4 أهداف خلال أول 3 مباريات خاضها ريال مدريد في الدوري الإسباني، ولعب 270 دقيقة كاملة، كما سدد 18 كرة على مرمى المنافسين، إلى جانب إكمال 111 تمريرة لزملائه.   👏 ¡Enhorabuena, @KMbappe ! ✨ Jugador Cinco Estrellas · Agosto ⚽ @FutbolMahou pic.twitter.com/oXTE2VlKOU — Real Madrid C.F. (@realmadrid) September 3, 2026 ورغم خسارته الجائزة، قدم جود بيلينجهام بداية قوية أيضًا مع ريال مدريد في "الليجا"، إذ شارك في 3 مباريات، سجل خلالها هدفين وصنع مثلهما خلال 245 دقيقة، ليساهم في 4 أهداف خلال أول ثلاث جولات من الموسم. ويستعد ريال مدريد لمواجهة ريال بيتيس، مساء الجمعة، ضمن منافسات الجولة الرابعة من الدوري الإسباني. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة". ويحتل الفريق الملكي المركز الثاني في جدول ترتيب "الليجا" برصيد 9 نقاط من أول ثلاث مباريات، بينما يدخل اللقاء وسط غيابات عديدة.

Unlike GTA 6, which will be more real than real, a psychosis-inducing perfect recreation of reality that we will be both unable and unwilling to tear ourselves from, Los Santos in GTA 5 is just sort of… stagey. It's a big Hollywood set (of Hollywood), all outside and no inside. I have now added the inside. I installed Open World Interiors , whose aim is to furnish various GTA 5 businesses with actual, inhabitable inside zones. items.title: Guild Wars 3 is a lot smaller scale than Guild Wars 2 because of the new approach to combat and movement: 'You would probably see about 20 players in a large combat scenario'
items.summary: Expect more clarity, but no more 100-player boss fights.
items.body: At Gamescom, I got to see a hands-off demo of Guild Wars 3 and chatted to the developers about what they have in store for us when the MMO hits beta next year. You can read about the significant changes to movement and combat in my Guild Wars 3 preview , but we also discussed how different the upcoming MMO's scale will be when compared to its predecessors. Guild Wars 3 sits between OG Guild Wars, which was very small scale, and Guild Wars 2, where you could fight a boss with a hundred other players. It still has that multiplayer focus, but compared to Guild Wars 2, ArenaNet has significantly reduced how many people you'll be playing with at once. "At most, out in the open world, you would probably see about 20 players in a large combat scenario," says game director Colin Johanson. "Our movement systems and our combat systems, in particular, are really high fidelity. They're designed to lend themselves to being able to see everything that's going on, and we felt like that number is where it starts to cap out. items.title: Zach Cregger doesn't want to get bogged down in 'the wild aspects' of Resident Evil's lore: 'I'm not going to have a gigantic jacked dude in a trench coat'
items.summary: The trench coat is actually integral to the build.

Maybe it's that Hunk spent a week lost in Raccoon City's sewers eating rats after getting his ass beaten by Birkin? Or perhaps it's that the Tyrant's trench coat is more than just a bold fashion statement—it's actually integral to the build. There's been a few explanations as to why Tyrants wear trench coats in Resident Evil games. One perk of the coat is that it helps disguise the mutations, which allows Tyrants to infiltrate more sensitive areas, but its biggest bonus is its power-limiting function. Wearing the trench coat holds the Tyrant together by preventing out-of-control mutations, and if it's damaged or the Tyrant removes it you'll get a Super Tyrant. The Zone—the real one—was established in 1986 following the disaster at the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant. It's not quite as fanciful as the videogame counterpart but it is hazardous, and public access is restricted; as one of the most radioactively contaminated regions on the planet, it's also of considerable scientific interest. Facilities in the zone also require ongoing maintenance, which became a problem when Russian troops seized the Zone and power plant during the early days of the invasion of Ukraine. items.body: If there's one thing that's become daunting about the modern RPG, it's the ballooning time investment. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation just had its release date dropped alongside a 10-minute gameplay deep dive during PlayStation's State of Play . In it, we got to see a closer look at the airship overworld. You are here, you are back, you have been impaled through the abdomen and killed. I have played perhaps 20 minutes of Alien: Isolation 2 at Gamescom 2026 and I can tell you this: it is certainly Alien: Isolation. There are some new wrinkles, though—where the first game was a strictly inside affair, stranding you on the space station Sevastopol, the second game sets you down planetside in an entirely new character's shoes. Fewer air vents, fewer vital systems shuddering to a halt; a lot more weather, a lot more space. You are Blake. items.summary: The recommended specs are a little over-generous so here are the settings I reckon you can compromise to gain some extra performance.
items.body: The Blood of Dawnwalker is a punishing game. And not just because of the divisive time-as-a-resource-to-be-managed side of things (or the almost impossible to resist desire to shift 'the' around in the title) but because it will slay your PC in terms of performance. We've covered the fact that in order to hit any of the performance level system requirements you have to enable upscaling in Balanced mode , but it's also worth noting that those system requirements are a little generous, too. I've been testing Dawnwalker for the past week or so, with a few different setups, and in those forests of Carpathia you're going to either need some more beefy hardware to hit Rebel Wolves' proposed frame rate targets or compromise on those graphics settings. Which is where I'm coming in here, aiming to help you get the highest frame rate out of your rig without sacrificing the actual look of the game. And, actually The Blood of Dawnwalker does pretty well even down at the lower end of the graphics settings, still looking relatively crisp and with a detailed open world for you to explore to your vampyric heart's content.
